criteria.description: Anchors pricing to the value delivered / the cost of the alternative (recruiter hours saved), explicitly pushing back on the cost-plus 'beats our $3 cost' / round-number reasoning.
Chooses a value metric that scales price with value (e.g. seats, roles/jobs, applicants screened) rather than one flat fee for all.
Designs good-better-best (or similar) packaging with who each tier targets, rather than a single price.
Defines fences between tiers and/or uses anchoring (premium/enterprise tier) deliberately, and considers expansion.
Checks or flags willingness-to-pay (survey/benchmark/validation) rather than assuming the numbers.
